role: The large and conifer tree generators of population and sapling growth: WorldGenBigTree (leaf nodes, limbs, trunk, carried heightLimit), WorldGenTaiga1, WorldGenTaiga2, WorldGenHugeTrees with WorldGenMegaPineTree (including the podzol patch) and WorldGenMegaJungle, WorldGenSavannaTree and WorldGenCanopyTree, plus their FeatureProbeTrees rows.

structs.name: bigtree
structs.java: a WorldGenBigTree instance during one generate (worldObj, basePos, heightLimit, height, leafDistanceLimit, rand, leafNodes)

structs.name: TREES
structs.java: the rows of oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/FeatureProbeTrees.java (bigtree, taiga1, taiga2, megapine x2, megajungle, savanna, canopy)

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left

line 352, function big_leaf_node_list: malloc of the node scratch array sized by heightLimit; line 410 malloc of b->nodes; lines 413 and 484 free (per-tree heap allocation, also on the sapling-growth path inside the tick)
lines 380-381, function big_leaf_node_list: libm sin/cos in place of StrictMath (fdlibm); header comment says they differ by up to one ulp on 3.3% of arguments, unobserved in 1200 recorded cases
line 364, function big_leaf_node_list: while loop bounded by dy >= 0
line 890, function feature_megajungle: branch loop stepping down by a random 2..5 until the trunk middle
notes: All writes go through features_tree_write (flag 2, or 3 when features_tree_notify is on for sapling growth). randomtick.c calls features_bigtree_reset for sapling growth; decorator.c uses feature_bigtree_state_set/get. Java member names for the WorldGenBigTree fields are MCP names from memory and not each verified against oracle/src. The megapine tall variant is selected by the row count field (field_150542_e).
